name: Ximena Valadez
career: Assistive technology specialist for a public school district
bio: Ximena spends her weekdays helping students and teachers set up speech devices, adaptive keyboards, and other tools that make classrooms more accessible. After work, she's just as likely to be at the gym hitting the heavy bag as she is repainting an old side table in her garage while stand-up clips and NBA recaps play on her phone. She has a soft spot for weird wildlife, so her son already has board books about frogs and insects next to her old arcade game memorabilia and Supernatural DVDs. A surprising quirk is that she keeps a handwritten notebook ranking Target loungewear finds, Giants games, and the best casserole recipes from family potlucks.
